## Change

Describe the user-visible or architectural outcome and the relevant ADR/milestone.

## Evidence

- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes
- [ ] Relevant negative/authorization tests pass
- [ ] Screenshot evidence is attached for UI changes and was visually inspected
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, real payment data, or production credentials were added
- [ ] External/live gates remain closed unless separately approved and evidenced

## Architecture

- [ ] No frozen V1 behavior changed
- [ ] A superseding ADR is included for any material decision change
